title: Compatibility with Accu-Chek Aviva Connect
body:
I'm unable to transfer glucose readings from an Aviva Connect via bluetooth. The meter successfully pairs to the smartphone (android 5.1), but the on/off slider in `settings -> glucose meters -> use bluetooth meter` cannot be toggled to "on". After pairing completes, no data transfer ever happens.

I followed the suggestion at https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/208#issuecomment-349717018 and then, with the meter paired and xDrip+ running in foreground, I initiated a manual data transfer from the meter, but nothing happens and the meter times out . The glucose meter contains a few readings in its memory.

I suppose this may be a misconfiguration of the data acquisition settings; the option `settings -> hardware data sources` is set to `Bluetooth Wixel`; I cannot find a more fitting identifier for this meter.

The meter appears to have preliminary support: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/a7b22bdcffe2899b819caa385f90ffbf0a8648a2

comments.body:
After the meter is paired, the label "Accu-Chek" appears under `settings -> glucose meters -> scan for bluetooth meter` with a yellow text showing what I assume is the meter's MAC address and the string "paired". Whenever I initiate the data transfer from the meter and simultaneously tap the "Accu-Chek" label inside this xDrip+ settings menu, the following two status messages appear on xDrip+ and rapidly alternate to each other, about 3 times per second:

```
Trying to connect to: 00:60:19:30:CC:6B
Connected to device: 00:60:19:30:CC:6B
```

but no transfer happens, and after a few seconds the meter displays a timeout error.

hi

did you measure at least one time BG? (just in case not)

Gregory

OP mentioned at the end of second paragraph that he did.
Same meter, I finally managed to get it to talk to xDrip by doing My Data-> Data Transfer->Wireless, after __disabling__ auto-send. Since then I reenabled auto-send and the transfer happens after I take each reading.

@davidebaldini Would you please close this issue if you have got answers?
If not, you can use the support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
